comparisons: Router logits/IDs/weights, assignment order/inverse/counts/starts, planned base/kind tables, complete weighted/unweighted expert slots, routed output and shared gate/up/activation/output are byte-exact. Input remains unchanged. A CPU F32 routed-plus-shared diagnostic additionally matches the source final; it does not qualify a GPU final-add implementation.

placement.quota_note: The fused one-expert window is not a one-expert total cache quota. Heavy groups retain up to five leased raw triples; their batch and padded row geometry never shrink to match the fused window. Each of the decode and temporary pools has an independent five-entry quota; their possible combined quota is 133155840 bytes.
placement.prefill: Misses use temporary GPU reservations without decode/RAM admission; zero decode eviction.
placement.decode: Misses admit to the bounded five-entry cache; all consumers synchronize before releasing expert leases.
placement.limits: Payload quotas exclude immutable core/parameters, decoded weight scratch, activation/index/state buffers, allocator/driver/library overhead. Uploads are synchronous. Reader bytes are logical source reads, not physical disk I/O. Cache hits are zero in these scans, so warm-cache behavior/performance is not qualified.
